name: Question 13
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix $A$ above has eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=1$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=-1.$ Find a diagonal matrix $D$ and an orthogonal matrix $P$ such that $D={P}^{T}\,AP.$
